title: API keys
description: Keys to call the Messer API from your systems: run agents and workflows, read traces or publish. They are shown once and stored only as a hash.
readOnly: Only admins can create or revoke API keys. You can see the existing ones.
viewerNotice: You need at least the Builder role to see the organization's API keys.
loadError: We couldn't load the API keys.

empty.title: No API keys yet
empty.description: Create a key to integrate Messer with your applications. You can limit it to one project and specific permissions.
empty.descriptionReadOnly: When an admin creates a key, it will show up here.

revokeDescription: Integrations using it stop working immediately. This can't be undone: you'll need to create a new key. It is recorded in the audit log.
footnote: Send the key in the Authorization: Bearer header. Every use updates the “Last used” column.

errors.invalid_scopes: A selected permission doesn't exist. Reload the page.
errors.not_found: The project or the key no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.forbidden: Only admins can manage API keys.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Credentials the project's code reads as environment variables.
secrets.scope: Values are encrypted and only reach this project's sandbox: no other project can read them and they are never shown again. Use them in code as environment variables and in MCP server headers as $NAME.
secrets.usageExample:
# Agent or workflow code
import os
token = os.environ["CRM_TOKEN"]

# MCP server header
Authorization: Bearer $CRM_TOKEN
secrets.readOnly: Only builders and admins can see and manage secrets.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.nameHint: UPPERCASE letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
secrets.existsHint: A secret with this name exists: its value will be replaced.
secrets.valueHint: It is never shown again after saving.

nameErrors.format: Use only UPPERCASE letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (e.g. CRM_TOKEN).
nameErrors.reserved: The MESSER_, ANTHROPIC_ and AWS_ prefixes are reserved by the platform.

empty.title: No secrets
empty.description: Add tokens or passwords of your systems to use them in tools and MCP servers without writing them in code.

secrets.replaceDescription: The previous value is replaced when you save; new runs use the new one.
secrets.deleteDescription: Tools and MCP servers using it stop receiving it in new runs. This can't be undone.

errors.invalid_name: Use only UPPERCASE letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (e.g. CRM_TOKEN).
errors.reserved_name: That prefix is reserved by the platform.
errors.not_found: That secret no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to manage this project's secrets.
